notes: save_safe/network_safe/rng_safe record that the patch was designed and reviewed to preserve compatibility in that dimension (versioned save additions, symmetric host/client state, deterministic seed-derived RNG) -- not that the dimension is untouched. See docs/ENGINE_PATCH_POLICY.md for the full narrative per patch.

0001-rtt-lua-item-label-filter-hook.patc.purpose: Expose a ShouldShowItemLabel(Item*) -> bool event to Lua for loot-filter policy.

0002-rtt-monster-resistance-display.patc.purpose: Show exact monster Magic/Fire/Lightning resistance/immunity without the vanilla kill-count gate.

0003-rtt-classic-plus-visual-store-defau.purpose: Default RTT Classic+ options to the reviewed native QoL set (Visual Grid vendors, etc.).

0004-rtt-item-comparison-tooltip.patch.purpose: Superseded by 0017: originally appended delta-comparison lines into the single hovered-item tooltip; that behavior was removed by 0017 in favor of two independent D2-style boxes. Still contributes the base PrintItemDetails/GetRttComparisonItem scaffolding 0017 builds on.

0005-rtt-weapon-swap.patch.purpose: Diablo-II-style second main/off-hand weapon set without changing PlayerPack.

0006-rtt-normal-xp-multiplier.patch.purpose: +50% earned XP on Normal difficulty for RTT games only; Nightmare/Hell untouched.

0007-rtt-phase4-itemization.patch.purpose: Phase 4 foundation: generateRttMetadata param, first Rare/Unique/Set generation and crafting hooks.

0008-rtt-necromancer-vertical-slice.patc.purpose: Necromancer class identity overlay on Sorcerer (getClassName() only).

0009-rtt-rare-serialization-hardening.pa.purpose: Mix affix slot index into RttRoll() so different slots never coincidentally roll identical values.

0010-rtt-phase4-completion.patch.purpose: RttNamedIdentity() plus the shared RttPrepareCraft/RttCraftHeldRare crafting-mutation engine.

0011-rtt-progression-hotkey.patch.purpose: F4 hotkey wrapper (RttSpendNextProgressionPoint) around the existing RttChooseProgression().

0012-rtt-waypoint-foundation.patch.purpose: RttWarpToLevel() reusing vanilla _pLvlVisited[]; no new save state.

0013-rtt-waypoint-panel-ui.patch.purpose: Full graphical D2-style waypoint panel (M hotkey in town), mirroring quest_log.cpp.

0014-rtt-physical-waypoints.patch.purpose: Physical clickable waypoint objects in town and every 2nd dungeon floor (reused OBJ_MCIRCLE1).

0015-fix-active-object-count-export.patc.purpose: Mark ActiveObjectCount DVL_API_FOR_TEST so Windows test builds link.

0016-rtt-town-service-objects.patch.purpose: Physical stash chest (reused OBJ_CHEST1) and crafting-anchor prop (reused OBJ_WEAPONRACK) in Tristram.

0017-rtt-d2-style-item-tooltip.patch.purpose: D2-style dual tooltip: hovering an item shows its own full stat box plus a second, fully independent box for the currently-equipped item in the same slot (never merged into one box). Wires this into inventory, stash, visual store and ground-item hover. Replaces patch 0004's single-box delta-comparison lines.

0018-rtt-debug-seed-stash-test-data.patc.purpose: _DEBUG-only Lua dev command (dev.seedStashTestData()) that drops test gold and a few reused generic items into the stash, so the physical stash chest from patch 0016 has content to manually test. Not real crafting materials - those don't exist yet.

0019-rtt-salvage-materials.patch.purpose: Sell/Salvage split: 4 new material items (Iron Scrap, Arcane Dust, Blood Shard, Radiant Shard) reusing existing vanilla cursor graphics, plus a 'Salvage Item' option at Griswold that destroys an equipped-type item for tiered materials by rarity.

0020-rtt-cain-horadric-knowledge.patch.purpose: Cain gets 'Identify All Items' (batched identify) and Horadric Knowledge progression (5 gold-gated crafting tiers, Level V additionally level-gated). Adds a new versioned rtt_crafting_state save archive entry for the purchased tier.
